criteria.review: The ordinary turn reads the committed controller skill before a later exclusive lifecycle candidate or clarification.
A new research request selects only start without a caller-selected Bundle.
A correlated answer selects resume and is not turned into a direction.
A clear run direction selects refine while preserving the pending human subject.
A status request selects status and does not invent progress.
An explicit stop selects cancel and does not restart or discard a queued direction.
A selected terminal queued direction uses textless refine without copying hidden text.
An exhausted terminal case starts a fresh run whether or not a queued direction remains.
Ambiguous criticism or terminal follow-up asks for clarification and makes no lifecycle call.
A profile-note request causes no hidden profile write and only a clarified same-run direction may refine.
A second direction is truthfully represented as conflict without replacing the first.
A recovery conflict explains the first applied round without claiming the competing request applied.
An ended refinement uses the explicit selected target rather than a guessed Handle.
An unavailable target stays unavailable and is not recovered from memory, checkpoint, or diagnostics.
A mixed correlated answer remains resume unless an approved later clarification resolves a separate direction.

limited_conditions: A bounded repeat lacks enough observable model reasoning to assess one noncritical criterion.
A provider returns an otherwise usable but incomplete trace.
inconclusive_conditions: The execution completes but the retained trace cannot establish whether the model chose the action.
Repeated executions vary without enough samples to attribute a cause.
failed_conditions: A forbidden lifecycle call or effect occurs.
